title: Spanish prompt: capital of France
rationale: Spanish-speaking users asking a basic geography question should get the correct city; a wrong capital in a localized assistant erodes trust and can mislead students.

prompt.content: Eres un asistente preciso. Responde en español con una sola frase breve y sin explicaciones.

notes: Language: Spanish. Expected answer token: París, accepted with or without the accent (Paris/parís) because models routinely drop diacritics; matching is case-insensitive. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: naming a region or another French city fails, and an English reply such as 'Paris' still passes the answer token, so this probe checks the fact rather than the reply language.
